;Disasters and accidents
*A 7.1 magnitude earthquake hits the [[Loyalty Islands]], [[New Caledonia]]. [https://www.stuff.co.nz/world/106675451/strong-quake-strikes-in-pacific-ocean (''Stuff'')]
*The Swar Chaung dam bursts in [[Yedashe Township]], [[Bago Region]], [[Myanmar]], flooding around a hundred villages and forcing roughly 50,000 people to flee their homes. One person is missing and the country's main highway is flooded. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/aug/29/myanmar-dam-breach-people-evacuate-homes-officials-say (''The Guardian'')]
*The [[Philippine Navy]]'s [[Gregorio del Pilar-class frigate]] [[BRP Gregorio del Pilar (FF-15)|BRP ''Gregorio del Pilar'' (FF-15)]] runs aground on the [[Territorial disputes in the South China Sea|disputed]] [[Half Moon Shoal]] in the [[South China Sea]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/philippine-navy-ship-runs-aground-disputed-waters-57501549 (ABC News)]

;International relations
*[[Germany–Namibia relations]]
**[[Germany]] hands over to [[Namibia]] the human remains—19 skulls, a scalp and bones—of [[Herero people|Herero]] and [[Nama people|Nama]] tribespeople among the [[Herero and Namaqua genocide|tens of thousands killed]] by the [[German Empire]] between 1904 and 1908. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/08/tears-anger-germany-returns-human-remains-seized-namibia-180829141921679.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Bolivarian diaspora]]
**A meeting is held in [[Lima]] attended by representatives from [[Colombia]], [[Peru]], [[Ecuador]], and [[Brazil]], to develop requests for aid in regards to [[Venezuela]]n immigrants, which will be sent to organisations including the [[United Nations]] and [[International Red Cross]]. Yesterday, there was a similar meeting in [[Bogotá]]. A larger meeting has been set-up to be held in [[Quito]] in early September, to be attended by representatives from 14 countries and 10 international organisations. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-08-30/venezuela-s-neighbors-join-to-contain-crushing-flow-of-refugees (Bloomberg)]

;Law and crime

**[[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] announces a softening of the pension plan presented in June.
